messages:
Nia (eng-sre): following up from the postmortem for the customer's Dedicated outage — root cause summary: intermittent VPC peering flap + on-prem NAT asymmetry caused session mismatches and triggered isolation. Need owners and short/medium-term fixes.

Hector (eng-runtime): I'll own the runtime mitigation: prefer KV fallback when peer health is degraded. Plan: feature flag + unit tests. ETA: 2026-04-10.

Priya (eng-platform): I'll build a preflight validator for Dedicated on-prem configs to detect asymmetrical NAT and missing static routes. Will push CI job and docs. ETA: 2026-04-14.

Sam (customer-success): Customer asked for an immediate mitigation — can we reduce idle timeouts and enable partial peer deprioritization during their maintenance window? They accepted a 30-min window.

infra-bot: maintenance scheduled by Sam: "Customer peering mitigation" 2026-04-07T01:00:00Z - 2026-04-07T01:30:00Z (ref: #maint-180250).

Nia (eng-sre): Action items (add tracker links in comments):
- I1: Peer-flap detectors + alerting (owner: Nia) due: 2026-04-09 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3720
- I2: Runtime KV fallback flag (owner: Hector) due: 2026-04-10 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3721
- I3: On-prem config validator + CI (owner: Priya) due: 2026-04-14 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3722
- I4: Interim config change + comms (owner: Sam) due: 2026-04-06 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3723

Hector (eng-runtime): added a test simulating NAT translation drift; failing snippet:
[2026-03-29T09:12:08Z] conn lost: src=10.2.5.6 translated=52.12.3.4 inconsistent -> isolation event
Linking RD-3721 after PR.

Priya (eng-platform): validator prototype uploaded to RD-3722. Quick check: run `redwood-validate --check-nat-symmetry` against customer config. Will add a blocking check on Dedicated onboarding.

Sam (customer-success): I've obtained customer approval for the maintenance and sent pre-window notes including rollback steps. They want the post-maintenance summary within 3 hours.

Nia (eng-sre): I'll add a rollback artifact and playbook to RD-3720 and schedule weekly check-ins (Wednesdays 16:00 UTC) until tickets are closed. If anyone is blocked, flag in the ticket. :triage:
